integrity.methods: Exhaustive independent cycle enumerations and two independent LZ76 parsers; proof of completeness in RESULT.md; standalone verify.py

scientific_limitations: Exact classification only for order-five binary de Bruijn cycles; standard complete-component LZ76 (including final reproducible phrase) is used. Earlier unindexed equivalent finite tables cannot be ruled out. No all-order or compressed-bit-size assertion.
title: Rotation-resolved Lempel–Ziv complexity of order-five binary de Bruijn cycles
